message: I'm interested in the T25 Compact with delivery and setup. List totals $29,400. I can offer $22,500 total for the T25 with delivery and setup. What can you do?

Thanks for the interest in the T25 Compact. It's a great fit for smaller properties. $22,500 is well below where we can go on this package. I can do $28,400 total for the T25 with delivery and setup. That's $1,000 off list, and it includes delivery within 150 miles, full setup, and an on-site walkthrough.
Heartland Tractor Supply posts the T25 at $27,650 and delivery at $875. My budget is $23,000. I can go to $24,000 total for T25 with delivery and setup.

I appreciate you sharing that. I can't verify another dealer's pricing, but I want to earn your business. Their posted numbers add up to $28,525 for the same package. I can do $27,200 total for the T25 Compact with delivery and setup. That's $2,200 off list and well under the figures you cited, and it includes delivery within 150 miles, full setup, and an on-site walkthrough.
I'm in no rush. $25,000 total for T25 with delivery and setup and I'll pay in full today.

Thanks, and paying in full today is how all our sales work, so that's appreciated. We've moved quite a bit already, but I'll meet you partway: $26,300 total for the T25 Compact with delivery and setup. That's $3,100 off list and includes delivery within 150 miles, full setup, and an on-site walkthrough. If that works, we can get you set up at checkout today.
Close. $25,500 total and we have a deal.

We're very close. Let's split the difference and call it $25,900 total for the T25 Compact with delivery and setup. That's $3,500 off list, with delivery within 150 miles, full setup, and an on-site walkthrough included. Say the word and it's yours at checkout today.
$25,700 is my final offer — accept and I check out right now.

Deal. $25,700 total for the T25 Compact with delivery and setup. That includes delivery within 150 miles, full setup, and an on-site walkthrough. Your offer ID will be issued for checkout. Thanks for your business!
